coord_notes.shape: Read with an exactly orthogonal \(Q\) and a frozen support: \(\rho(E)=W_0S(P_r,Q(E))\) lies in the leaf \(W_0\cdot SO(V)\). If \(\operatorname{rank}W_0P_r^{\top}=r\), \(W_0\cdot O(V)=(W_0+W_0P_r^{\top}\mathbb R^{r\times r}P_r)\cap W_0\cdot O(n)\). The released Cayley–Neumann default is not exactly orthogonal and leaves the leaf.
coord_notes.base_point: \(S_1=W_0P_r^{\top}\mathfrak{so}(r)P_r\), of dimension \(r(r-1)/2=d\) when \(\operatorname{rank}W_0P_r^{\top}=r\): regular, unlike HRA's paired initialisation (Thm II.7(b)).
coord_notes.gauge: \(E\mapsto W_0P_r^{\top}Q(E)P_r\) is injective near \(0\) when \(W_0P_r^{\top}\) has full column rank.
coord_notes.covariance: OxO for the principal and GradSVD supports, whose frames come from SVDs of \(W_0\) or \(G\). The SkewGrad support is covariant under the larger group \(GL(m)\times CO(n)\), since \(W_0^{\top}G\) is unchanged by an output change of basis. In this catalogue block OFT is GLxCO and GOFT is \(\Pi\).
coord_notes.rebasing: With the support frozen across cycles the image is a subgroup orbit and merge-and-restart gains nothing. With finitely many supports revisited, the reach is the orbit of the connected group whose Lie algebra the \(\mathfrak{so}(V_k)\) generate (Thm V.3(b)); numerically SO(n) for generic supports, r >= 2, after ceil(n/r) of them. The principal support does not move when re-selected.

methods.categorical_reading: LOFT fixes one leaf of the HRA meet: for injective \(W_0\), \((W_0+\mathcal M_{\le r})\cap W_0\cdot SO(n)\) is the union over \(V\in\mathrm{Gr}(r,n)\) of the leaves \(W_0\cdot SO(V)\). HRA moves its leaf while it trains; LOFT freezes it and chooses it, from the principal singular subspace (PSOFT without its tori; for injective \(W_0\) and a Cayley map, LoRA-XS meet exact full-block Cayley OFT) or from the gradient at \(\theta_0\). Read with an exactly orthogonal transform, it is an orbit method with a regular base point and no gauge.

arrows.note: Into exact full-block Cayley OFT (block size n), with the same Cayley map on both sides. With the catalogue's convention W = W_0 C(Q)^T, h(E) = -P_r^T E P_r; with HF's exact code R = (I-Q)(I+Q)^{-1}, W = W_0 R^T, it is h(E) = +P_r^T E P_r. Uses C(P_r^T E P_r) = I + P_r^T (C(E) - I) P_r.
Principal support, needs sigma_r(W_0) > 0; LoRA-XS pointed at R = 0. Holds for any transform Q, exact or not.

Principal support, same exactly orthogonal transform on both sides; freeze PSOFT's two scaling vectors at 1 (A2 up to E -> -E). With alpha = beta = 1, PSOFT's W_res + B R^T A equals W_0 (I + V_r (R^T - I) V_r^T).
Into LoRA_r pointed at (B, A) = (0, P_r), a T_A-type pointing with a fixed row-orthonormal A_0.

obstructions.reason: For r >= 4 there is no smooth pointed arrow LOFT_r -> HRA_r at HF's paired initialisation, although Im LOFT(P_r) lies in Im HRA_r (r even): S_1(LOFT) = W_0 so(V) is not contained in S_1(HRA) = W_0 {Omega : P_{U^perp} Omega P_{U^perp} = 0} (Thm II.7(b)), because dim(V cap U^perp) >= r/2 >= 2.
